notes:
Dahu 0.98.3 beta for Windows

- Fixed object snaps for the first point of planar drawing tools when the target is outside the initial construction plane. This covers Circle, Rectangle, Ellipse, centre Arc and planar Box/Cylinder methods.
- The first anchor establishes the drawing elevation while preserving plane orientation and the global CPlane. Later points retain their plane constraint.
- Explicit Project, visible-only snapping in Shaded and 3D construction methods keep their behaviour.

Validated with 152 workflow checks, a 32-case command/method point-picking matrix, and isolated Windows desktop, native snap and updater signature checks.
